# OnePeak

> OnePeak is the personal website of independent software developer Finn Wang. It introduces Poise, KeyPresser, and File Occupied Release and links to each project's official website. OnePeak 是独立开发者 Finn Wang 的个人主页，展示三个项目及其官网。

## Developer / 开发者

- [中文主页](https://onepeak.cn/): 作品与开发者介绍。
- [English homepage](https://onepeak.cn/en/): Project portfolio and developer profile.
- [Finn Wang on GitHub](https://github.com/FinnWang-CN): Developer profile, repositories and releases.

## Projects / 项目

- [Poise · 轻衡](https://poise.onepeak.cn/en/): A local-first body journal for recording changes and reviewing trends. The OnePeak portfolio lists Android, iOS, and Web.
- [KeyPresser](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/index-en.html): A Windows keyboard and mouse automation tool with macro recording and playback. [中文官网](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/)
- [File Occupied Release · 文件占用释放](https://fileoccupiedrelease.onepeak.cn/en/): A Windows utility that identifies processes using selected files and lets users close selected processes. [中文官网](https://fileoccupiedrelease.onepeak.cn/?lang=zh)
